newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR rates steady to softer.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR rates steady to softer.

text.p: Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) were mostly steady on Thursday, with only the two-month and six-month rates softer, traders said.

PHIBOR mirrored the high liquidity at the money market where rates have been prevented from falling by the Central Bank, traders said. The Central Bank had been borrowing at an overnight rate of 10.5 percent, traders said.

Most banks, however, believe rates may have already bottomed out. The Central Bank has not lowered its money market rates since the peso was hammered by speculation late last week due to a sharp fall in domestic rates.
